name: bamboohr-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your BambooHR data: employees, custom fields, tables, time off, training and holidays. Read-only.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to BambooHR with your own API key. You see exactly what you can see in BambooHR. The connector never creates, approves or changes anything.

bamboohr_token.title: BambooHR API key
bamboohr_token.description: Your personal API key. Create it in BambooHR: profile photo (bottom left) > API Keys > Add New Key.

company_domain.title: Company subdomain
company_domain.description: Only the first part of the address. If BambooHR opens at acme.bamboohr.com, enter: acme

vacation_type.title: Vacation time-off type (optional)
vacation_type.description: Fill in only if the tool says it cannot identify the vacation type. Use the exact name shown in BambooHR.
